Class GameController

java.lang.Object
com.comp2042.GameController
All Implemented Interfaces:
InputEventListener
public class GameController extends Object implements InputEventListener
The main controller for the game logic. It acts as a bridge between the user interface (GUI) and the game's core logic (Board). It handles user input events, updates the game state, and manages the overall game flow.

  • Method Details

    • initGame

      public void initGame(GameMode mode)
      Initializes the game with a specific game mode. This method sets up the game board, resets the timer, and updates the UI for the new game.
      Parameters:
      mode - The game mode to initialize (e.g., Classic, Sprint, Ultra).

    • onGameEvent

      public Object onGameEvent(GameEvent event)
      Handles incoming game events from the user interface. This method is the central point for processing user actions like moving or rotating bricks.
      Specified by:
      onGameEvent in interface InputEventListener
      Parameters:
      event - The game event to process.
      Returns:
      An object containing data for the UI to update, or null if no update is needed.
